what: Option B candidate gene sets for T2's secondary, descriptive comparison (pre-registration 2.2 item 2 (b)): records of the registered search that reached full text, passed E1, E2 and E5, and whose expression-only risk score names every term in readable text (R1). Symbols are as printed; R2 (presence in both TCGA and CGGA) is applied by scripts/t2_comparator.py select. Fixed and committed before any gene set was fitted.
extraction: one reviewer per paper (protocol docs/t2_comparator_search/protocols/4_gene_sets.md); every terms_evidence quote checked by script against its source file; 7 ambiguous records adjudicated against eligibility

screen.detail: E2: Single-gene paper (MAPKAPK2); the 'risk score' is just high/low MAPKAPK2 expression, no multi-gene risk score proposed.
R1: Risk score is built on PSI values of alternative-splicing events; the final model events are not named in text (only figures and supplementary tables).
E2: Metabolism subtype classification and PCA-based MRG score for subtype membership; no survival risk score. Five single hub genes tested individually.
E2: Single-gene study (HIF1A expression) with nomogram including clinical covariates; no multi-term expression risk score proposed.
R1: No expression risk score with named terms: prognosis uses a P-NPC ssGSEA score from marker genes listed only in a heatmap figure, and the nomogram adds age and treatment scores.
E2: Paper proposes no multi-gene risk score; single lncRNA NDUFA6-DT as biomarker, nomogram with clinical terms built on that single gene.
E2: No risk score: GSVA/consensus clusters (C1-C3) of redox network signatures; subtype membership with KM comparisons only.
E2: 20-gene ANN uses mutation status as inputs and predicts immunotherapy response (responder/nonresponder), not an OS risk score; also mutation-based.
R1: Risk score built from 21 prognostic chemotherapy-related genes, but the genes appear only in a forest plot (Figure 2a); no readable text or supplement lists them.
R1: the text states 31 genes in two places and lists 21; the unweighted score's terms are ambiguous.
R1: Glyco-model of nine genes (lasso/Cox) for OS, but the nine genes are not named in main text and there is no supplement; terms only in figures.
E2: Paper builds multiomics molecular subtypes and subtype predictors; no expression risk score for OS.
E2: Risk score is a logistic-regression 2-year-survival (binary) class from genes, not a continuous OS risk model; not an OS relation per protocol.
R1: the five-gene model's formula is an image; the Results' 13-gene LASSO set and the Discussion's five genes disagree.
R1: the published model (Table 2) combines 19 transcripts with 2 radiomic features; the risk score itself includes non-expression terms.
E2: Paper reports single-gene COPZ2 expression and a nomogram with clinical covariates; no multi-gene risk score proposed.
R1: the third gene is HNRNPC in the abstract and validation but RBM15 in a Results sentence.

R1: Risk score is built from PSI values of alternative splicing events; the final seven AS events are not named in text (only figures); supplementary tables list only top events/genes, not model terms.
R1: Only SH2D4A is a named expression term; the LASSO risk score is described via figures with no gene list or coefficients in text; terms not named in readable text.
R1: eGBM-molGPA is a clinical/molecular grading score (KPS, surgical extent, MGMT, SVZ, TMT, TERT, TP53), not a function of bulk expression.
E2: Random forest/XGBoost classify binary survival status of glioma patients, not a risk score related to overall survival time.
E2: Studies three single genes (TWIST2, GATA3, HES5) individually; no multi-gene risk score proposed.

R1: Final score is a pathway activation level (17-gene GBM TMZ pathway, +/-1 weights times case-to-normal ratio against external healthy-brain controls), not a bulk-tumour-only fitted risk score; unsure, so fail. Biomarker/TMZ-response framing.
R1: Formula in Fig 7 legend names 4 genes (SOD3, SPAG4, FREM3, SPP1) but text repeatedly says five model genes; fifth term unaccounted for, so terms uncertain.
R1: two risk scores are published (8 genes; 3 genes) and both are validated; which is final is ambiguous.
E2: the paper reports 'survival' without stating overall survival; the risk-score formula is not given.
E2: the paper reports 'survival' without stating overall survival.
R1: The 12 hub genes of the mitophagy risk model are not named in text (only Venn diagram/heatmap figures); only BNIP3, HK2, FBXL4, ATG5, SNX7 appear incidentally.
E2: Single gene (CTF1) prognostic analysis and nomogram with CTF1 plus clinical factors; no multi-gene risk score.
E2: No prognostic risk score; transcriptomic ferroptosis/lncRNA/ceRNA analysis and CIRBP cell experiments only.
